{"metadata":{"description":"Drive the DeepSeek Harness agent on this computer from your phone, in QQ.","id":"gh:1416814619","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-qq-plugin","slug":"xcisxc29/dsh-qq-plugin","topics":["ai-agent","automation","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","qq","qq-bot","remote-control"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Drive the DeepSeek Harness agent on this computer from your phone, in QQ."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-qq-plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Drive the DeepSeek Harness agent on this computer from your phone, in QQ."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"It goes through **Tencent's official QQ bot platform** (`api.bot.qq.com`, bound by scanning a QR
cod"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e), so there is **no public IP to expose, no reverse proxy, and no third-party protocol client**
in "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"the middle. Bind once, and it keeps working."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Runs on the current DSH desktop app** — developed and tested against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This is the QQ counterpart of dsh-wechat-plugin. It is
feature-aligned with it, with a few deliberat"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"e departures where the QQ protocol makes the WeChat

> from my desktop"* in QQ and the agent finds the file on the computer, sends it back, and confirm"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"s
> with *"sent — DSH 自画像.png on the desktop (29 KB, PNG)"*. The **＋** at the right of the composer
"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"> is the attachment entry: images, videos, voice and files all go in that way
> (see Media in both d"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"tachment entry: images, videos, voice and files all go in that way
> (see Media in both directions)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Text both ways.** A QQ message becomes a DSH prompt, and the reply comes back to QQ.
- **Images,"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" files and voice in; images, videos and files out.** Attachments are saved into the
session workspac"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"e and handed to the agent; the agent sends files back with `send_to_qq`.
**A reply that runs long is"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" turned into a `.md` file** and sent to your phone instead of being cut.
- **One QQ chat, many DSH c"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"onversations.** `/new`, `/list`, `/switch`, `/current`, `/cancel` — or
just say "switch to the other"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" one". The list has **session folders** and **sessions** as two levels.
- **Pick the model and the r"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"easoning level from your phone too.** `/model` lists the models with
each one's reasoning levels; `/"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"model 2` and `/model 等级 high` switch them, effective from the
**next** step.
- **Answer permission p"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"rompts and questions from your phone.** Approvals are answered with
「允许」/「拒绝」 (allow/deny) or a numb"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"ered option; the agent's multiple-choice questions arrive in
QQ with numbered options and a digit an"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"swers them — being away from the desk does not stall the task.
- **Proactive push.** `notify_qq` let"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"s any session on this machine message you — that is what makes
"tell me when it is done" work. It wo"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"rks in practice: a ten-message burst was delivered in full,
and the last six of those went out as pr"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"oactive pushes. (Tencent's rules for unsolicited sends can
change and **the plugin assumes no quota*"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"*; anything undelivered is queued and flushed the next
time you speak.)
- **Scheduled tasks.** Run t"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"hrough the DSH host's own `schedule_create` / `schedule_list` /
`schedule_delete` / `schedule_update"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"` — just say "wake me at 23:12". The plugin does not
reimplement what DSH already has; it is only th"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"e channel.
- **Settings page** under **Settings → QQ** — nine settings, a native folder picker, and "},{"id":"p10s19","text":" **Settings page** under **Settings → QQ** — nine settings, a native folder picker, and diagnostics."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**For the DSH desktop app** on a machine that stays on. It needs DSH's workspace, tool and UI
servic"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"es — the standard desktop composition."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| DSH desktop | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer |
| Phone | mobile QQ, to scan one "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"QR code |
| QQ bot | **nothing to register in advance.** The bot application is created by that scan"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"; you do not need an AppID/AppSecret beforehand |
| Tencent's rules | an **uncertified** bot is usab"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"le only by its administrator — that is, only by you, which is exactly what a personal remote control"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"by its administrator — that is, only by you, which is exactly what a personal remote control wants |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Open the **plugin** entry in the sidebar and choose **添加插件** (add plugin). The field takes a
package"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" name, a Git URL, a tarball, or a local path."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> ### The name to install is `dsh-qq-plugin`
>
> The repository and the package share one name, so t"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"here is nothing to reconcile — but the
> `-plugin` suffix is easy to drop by accident. **Copy `dsh-q"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"q-plugin` rather than typing it.** The
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Only you can reach it.** The channel talks to Tencent's official QQ bot service and nothing else —"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"
no third-party service, no self-hosted relay in the middle. The bot is a **separate application**
w"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"hose administrator is your QQ account, and it was created by your own scan; an uncertified bot is
li"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"mited to its administrator. It is not a QQ contact you can hand out: nothing searches for it and
nob"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ody can add it. There is no "someone else could message it" surface, which is why no allowlist
exist"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"s: the platform's own rules already are one."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**The AppSecret is a long-lived key, and it is treated as one.** It is written to DSH's credential
s"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"tore as a `grant` record rather than into the plugin's plaintext state file, which keeps only the
Ap"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"pID. Rotating it means binding again from the settings page."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Three things are still true and worth knowing:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Conversations from QQ run with full permissions by default** — the agent does not ask before it
ac"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ts. That is deliberate: a permission prompt is delivered to QQ and the task then waits there, so
on "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"a phone every command would stall until you answered a conversation you had walked away from. Set
**"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"Permission preset for QQ conversations** to `auto` (or to the profile's own policy) in the settings
"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"page if you want the same guardrails you have at the desk."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**The agent runs as you.** It can execute commands and read and write files, with your user's
permis"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"sions — that is what it is for, and it means anything you can do on this machine, it can do.
So: ski"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"m what you asked for before walking away, and **lock the screen** when you leave. Locking does
not s"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"top the agent, and it keeps anyone passing by out of your desktop."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Any session on this machine can push to your QQ by default.** That is what makes "tell me when it
"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"is done" work: the session doing the work is usually not the one your QQ conversation is bound to,
a"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"nd without this it could not report its own result. Turn off **allowCrossSessionNotify** to restore
"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"the stricter rule, where only the bound session may send."}],"truncated":true}
